name: Automotive Dry Guide Coat Kit
description: Highlights low spots, sanding scratches and remaining surface imperfections during block sanding. Choose a product compatible with the primer and paint system.

name: Automotive Paint Preparation Tack Cloths
description: Used according to paint-system instructions to lift light residual dust before coating; avoid excessive pressure or residue transfer.

name: Lisle 28800 Digital Test Light
description: A practical automotive circuit tester for checking power and circuit behavior during classic-car electrical diagnosis.

name: NOCO GENIUS1 Smart Battery Charger & Maintainer
description: A compact 6V/12V smart charger and maintainer that fits the needs of classic cars that may spend time parked between drives.

name: Klein Tools 3005CR Ratcheting Crimper
description: A full-cycle ratcheting crimper for insulated automotive terminals, useful for making cleaner and more consistent wiring repairs.

name: NOCO GENIUS5 5A Smart Battery Charger & Maintainer
description: A higher-output smart charger and maintainer for 6V and 12V batteries, useful for collector cars that sit between drives.

name: NOCO Boost Plus GB40 Jump Starter
description: A compact portable jump starter that is easy to keep in the garage or take along on road trips in a classic car.

name: Battery Tender 3A Battery Charger & Maintainer
description: A practical charger and maintainer for preserving battery health in cars that spend extended time parked.

name: Fluke 117 True-RMS Digital Multimeter
description: A professional-grade multimeter for voltage, resistance, continuity and electrical troubleshooting when accuracy matters.

name: Power Probe III Circuit Tester
description: A versatile automotive circuit tester for quickly checking power, ground, continuity and component operation.

name: Kicker 53KEY200.4 4-Channel Smart Amplifier
description: The amp I bought for my own '66 Corvette convertible: 50 watts x 4 with a built-in processor that tunes itself using the included microphone. It is small enough to mount in the base of the waterfall console behind the radio, which is where mine is going.

name: Kicker 51KSC404 KS-Series 4-Inch Coaxial Speakers
description: The front speakers in my '66 Corvette audio build: a 4-inch pair that tucks behind the factory dash grille, so the dash still looks stock. The car came with one lonely dash speaker — these, run off the KEY200.4 amp, are the fix.

name: Kenwood KFC-693 6x9 5-Way Concert Series Speakers
description: The rear speakers in my 66 Corvette audio build: a 6x9 five-way pair with the voice to be heard with the top down. Mine hide behind generic grilles I painted to match the interior silver, so the rear deck still looks period.

name: Klein Tools 11055 Wire Stripper/Cutter
description: A dependable wire stripper and cutter for clean electrical repairs and harness work on older vehicles.

name: Heat-Shrink Electrical Connector Assortment
description: A useful assortment for making sealed, more durable wiring repairs in engine bays, interiors and lighting circuits.

name: GEARWRENCH 85077 1/2-Inch Electronic Torque Wrench
description: A precise electronic torque wrench for critical fasteners where consistent torque matters during mechanical work.

name: Sunex 1848 1/4-Inch Drive Master Impact Socket Set
description: A broad impact-socket set that covers many common fastener sizes encountered during restoration and maintenance.

name: DEWALT ATOMIC DCF921B 20V MAX 1/2-Inch Impact Wrench
description: A compact cordless impact wrench that is easy to maneuver around suspension, brake and drivetrain work.

name: OTC 5610 Transmission/Engine Oil Pressure Kit
description: A professional diagnostic kit with high- and low-pressure gauges for checking engine and transmission oil-pressure systems.

name: Mityvac MV8000 Automotive Test & Bleeding Kit
description: A hand-vacuum kit useful for brake bleeding, vacuum diagnostics and several common garage troubleshooting jobs.

name: Lisle 63600 Oil Filter Tool
description: A compact oil-filter tool that can help reach filters in tighter engine-bay locations.

name: GEARWRENCH 24-Inch 1/2-Inch Drive Breaker Bar
description: A long-handled breaker bar for stubborn fasteners where additional leverage is safer than abusing a ratchet.

name: Mayhew Pro Brass Drift Punch Set
description: Brass punches are useful around finished or softer components where a steel punch can leave unnecessary damage.

name: Magnetic Parts Tray Set
description: Simple, inexpensive trays that keep nuts, bolts and small hardware organized during disassembly and reassembly.

name: Telescoping Magnetic Pickup Tool
description: One of those inexpensive tools that earns its place the first time a fastener disappears into an engine bay.

name: Rechargeable Magnetic LED Work Light
description: A hands-free rechargeable work light is invaluable under dashboards, beneath cars and inside dark engine compartments.

name: 3M Performance Yellow Masking Tape 301+
description: A quality automotive masking tape for cleaner paint edges and more controlled masking during body and refinishing work.

name: 3M Scotch-Brite 7447 General Purpose Hand Pads
description: Useful abrasive hand pads for surface preparation, cleaning and scuffing where conventional sandpaper is awkward.

name: Automotive Trim Removal Tool Kit
description: Plastic trim tools help remove moldings, clips and interior panels while reducing the chance of scratches and broken trim.

name: Flexible Automotive Sanding Block Set
description: A range of flexible sanding blocks helps follow body contours and produce straighter, more consistent panel preparation.

name: Meguiar's Ultimate Compound G17216
description: A widely used paint-correction compound for removing oxidation, defects and light scratches from many automotive finishes.

name: Meguiar's Smooth Surface Clay Kit G191700
description: A clay-bar kit for removing bonded surface contamination before polishing or waxing a classic-car finish.

name: 303 Aerospace Protectant
description: A preservation-focused protectant for vinyl, rubber and other surfaces that benefit from UV protection without a greasy finish.

name: Griot's Garage PFM Terry Weave Drying Towel
description: A highly absorbent microfiber drying towel that helps reduce rubbing and unnecessary contact with finished paint.

name: Griot's Garage PFM Edgeless Detailing Towels
description: Soft edgeless microfiber towels suited to final wipe-downs, quick detailers and delicate painted surfaces.

name: Lisle 24680 Spill-Free Funnel
description: A funnel kit with adapters that fits the radiator neck so you can fill and burp the cooling system without spilling coolant everywhere. Handy after any cooling-system work on an older car.

name: DEWALT DCF911B 20V MAX 1/2-Inch Impact Wrench (Tool Only)
description: A compact cordless 1/2-inch impact wrench, rated 250 ft-lb tightening and 400 ft-lb breakaway torque. Tool only — battery and charger are sold separately, so it makes the most sense if you are already on DEWALT 20V MAX.

name: Knipex 87 01 250 Cobra Water Pump Pliers, 10-Inch
description: A 10-inch Cobra water-pump pliers with a push-button adjustment that locks onto the pipe or fitting. German-made, and the kind of pliers that earns its keep around hose clamps and fittings.

name: NOCO GENIUS2 2A Smart Battery Charger & Maintainer
description: A 2-amp smart charger and maintainer for 6V and 12V batteries, including lithium and AGM. A step up from the GENIUS1 for cars that sit a while between drives.

name: Battery Tender Junior 12V 750mA Charger & Maintainer
description: A small 750mA 12V charger and maintainer for lead-acid batteries from 3 to 30Ah. Best suited to motorcycles, ATVs and smaller batteries — too small to recharge a full-size car battery quickly, but fine for keeping one topped up.

name: STA-BIL Storage Fuel Stabilizer, 32 oz (22214)
description: Keeps gasoline fresh for up to 24 months in a stored car, so you do not have to drain the tank before winter. One ounce treats up to 2.5 gallons.

name: Griot's Garage G9 Random Orbital Polisher 10901
description: A 1000-watt dual-action random orbital polisher with a 6-inch backing plate. The random orbit makes it hard to burn paint, which is what you want in a first polisher. Bare tool — pads, compound and polish are sold separately.
